name: mild.run
description: Human approval gate for AI agents. Intercepts Stripe, Gmail, and Slack actions — sends a notification (Telegram or email) to approve or block before anything executes. No code, no webhook, no SDK. Free tier: 30 approvals/month.

authentication.description: Your personal MCP token from mild.run/dashboard. Paste it as `mcp_token` in each tool call, or include it in the server URL: `https://mcp.mild.run/mcp?mcp_token=YOUR_TOKEN`.

tools.name: stripe_refund
tools.description: Issue a Stripe refund — requires human approval before executing.

tools.name: stripe_subscription_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a Stripe subscription — requires human approval before executing.

tools.name: stripe_customer_delete
tools.description: Delete a Stripe customer — requires human approval before executing.

tools.name: stripe_payout
tools.description: Create a Stripe payout — requires human approval before executing.

tools.name: gmail_send_email
tools.description: Send a Gmail message — requires human approval before executing.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Send a Slack message — requires human approval before executing.

tools.name: get_approval_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a pending approval request.
